*You're coordinating dinner on Thursday, Oct 22.* Nobody had claimed it, so Dinnerbell picked you at random.

*While the vote is open:*
• Tap ⋯ beside a pick to decide it, break a tie, or set pickup or delivery
• Shuffle the picks

*After it's decided:*
• Change how you get it and who does it
• If that isn't clear, choose within 15 minutes or by the meal time. Otherwise, the first person who offered does it.

*Can't do it?* Hand it off on the call's page.

Thanks for steering!
